context_card.cerita: Pukul 20.00 Nenek masih menghitung uang arisan RT di lemari kecil bawah telepon. Pukul 21.30 lemari itu ternganga dan amplopnya kosong. Gerbang sudah dikunci Pak Tono, jadi uangnya pasti masih tersembunyi di ruang tamu.

clue_awal.teks: Siapa pun yang memakai kartu ATM menyelipkan uangnya di balik lukisan.

rt_lemari.teks: Engsel pintu lemari kecil dicopot. Keempat sekrupnya tergeletak di dalam, sementara kuncinya tetap utuh.

rt_rak.teks: Di balik buku sejarah Om Hendra terselip gepokan uang yang diikat karet.

rt_keset.teks: Keset depan basah. Hanya ada satu jejak baru di lantai: sepatu ukuran 43, menuju lemari telepon.

rt_telepon.teks: Buku tamu di samping telepon: "Bu Wati pulang pukul 19.30." Ada tanda tangan Pak Tono di bawahnya.

rt_kolong.teks: Di kolong sofa hanya ada debu dan remah kue lapis.

rt_lukisan.teks: Di balik lukisan hanya ada sarang laba-laba. Debu di bingkainya utuh, tidak tersentuh.

rt_tirai.teks: Tirainya basah terkena tampias hujan. Tidak ada apa-apa di baliknya.

rt_kursi.teks: Saputangan basah keringat tertinggal di sandaran kursi mustard. Baunya seperti kretek.

rt_jam.teks: Jam dinding menunjukkan 21.42. Detaknya terdengar lebih keras di tengah ketegangan.

rt_foto.teks: Di foto ini Om Benny masih berambut. Sudah lama sekali.

rt_sofa.teks: Bantal sofa empuk dan hangat. Si Belang baru saja pindah dari sini.

rt_meja.teks: Sepiring kue lapis tinggal separuh. Bukan urusanmu malam ini.

teks_kosong_bawaan: Kamu memeriksanya dengan teliti, tapi tidak ada yang mencurigakan.

penjelasan.teks: Pelakunya kidal: Om Benny atau Bu Wati.
Bu Wati sudah pulang pukul 19.30, sebelum uangnya hilang. Jejak sepatu ukuran 43 juga milik Om Benny.
Sekrup engsel dicopot dan kuncinya utuh: lemarinya dibongkar pakai obeng.
Gepokan uang terselip di balik buku di rak buku.

komentar_nenek: Benny, kalau usahamu sedang seret, bilang sama Ibu. Jangan bongkar lemari pakai obeng, engselnya mahal.

en.judul: The Savings-Club Money in the Phone Cabinet
en.cerita: At 8:00 p.m. Grandma was still counting the neighborhood savings-club money in the small cabinet under the phone. At 9:30 p.m. the cabinet was wide open and the envelope was empty. Mr. Tono had already locked the gate, so the money must still be hidden in the living room.

clue_awal.A2: Whoever used an ATM card slipped the money behind the painting.

benda.rt_lemari: The hinges of the small cabinet door have been removed. All four screws are lying inside, while the lock is untouched.
benda.rt_rak: A wad of cash tied with a rubber band is tucked behind Uncle Hendra's history book.
benda.rt_keset: The front doormat is wet. There's only one fresh set of footprints on the floor: size 43 shoes, heading to the phone cabinet.
benda.rt_telepon: The guest book next to the phone: "Mrs. Wati went home at 7:30 p.m." Mr. Tono signed below it.
benda.rt_kolong: Under the sofa there's only dust and crumbs of layered cake.
benda.rt_lukisan: Behind the painting there's only a spider web. The dust on the frame is undisturbed.
benda.rt_tirai: The curtains are wet from the rain blowing in. There's nothing behind them.
benda.rt_kursi: A sweat-soaked handkerchief is left on the back of the mustard armchair. It smells like clove cigarettes.
benda.rt_jam: The wall clock says 9:42 p.m. Its ticking sounds louder in all this tension.
benda.rt_foto: In this photo Uncle Benny still has hair. That was a long time ago.
benda.rt_sofa: The sofa cushions are soft and warm. Belang just moved off them.
benda.rt_meja: A plate of layered cake, half gone. Not your concern tonight.

en.teks_kosong_bawaan: You check it carefully, but nothing looks suspicious.
penjelasan: The culprit is left-handed: Uncle Benny or Mrs. Wati.
Mrs. Wati went home at 7:30 p.m., before the money disappeared. The size 43 footprints also belong to Uncle Benny.
The hinge screws were removed and the lock is intact: the cabinet was taken apart with a screwdriver.
The wad of cash was tucked behind a book on the bookshelf.
en.komentar_nenek: Benny, if your business is struggling, tell your mother. Don't take the cabinet apart with a screwdriver; those hinges are expensive.
